quarterly_data.quarter: Innoscience interim results announcement: Six Months Ended 30 June 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 interim results (unaudited): revenue RMB833.62 million, up 50.6% year on year; gross profit RMB97.08 million (up 156.50%), gross margin 11.6% (6.8% a year earlier) on a higher share of high-margin products and scale-driven cost reduction; loss for the period RMB309,079 thousand (H1 2025 RMB428,672 thousand); net operating cash flow turned positive. By product: GaN discrete devices and ICs RMB230.5 million (+11.1%), GaN wafers RMB187.5 million (+73.5%) on more strategic-customer orders, GaN modules RMB411.8 million (+74.4%). Revenue from high-end applications (AI data centers, industrial and energy storage, new energy vehicles) was RMB532.27 million (+70%); consumer electronics RMB301.40 million (+26%); energy storage and industrial sales +83%; 547 million chips shipped in H1 (over 2.5 billion cumulative).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB833.62 million (+50.6%); gross margin 11.6%; high-end applications RMB532.27 million (+70%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Innoscience interim results announcement: Six Months Ended 30 June 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI data centers (H1 2026 interim results): shipments of chips for AI and data center applications rose 183% year on year. For 800V HVDC it developed chips for 5.5kW AC-DC, 800V HVDC, 48V/12V and 6V/1V solutions; over 100 high-voltage chip products for 800V HVDC and 100V medium-voltage products for 48V/12V have design-ins from more than 20 leading global CSP vendors, and some have started mass production and delivery to multiple leading global enterprises. New 700V GaN products for AI 800VDC completed customer onboarding and entered mass production; 15V DrGaN products for 6V/1V GPU final-stage power completed sample testing at leading customers. Products have entered large-scale delivery to multiple top-tier server and power-supply makers (not named), and the company says shipments will keep growing rapidly as high-voltage DC architectures penetrate.
quarterly_data.figure: AI / data-center chip shipments +183% YoY; design-ins at more than 20 global CSP vendors

quarterly_data.quarter: Innoscience interim results announcement: Six Months Ended 30 June 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Operations and outlook (H1 2026 interim results): the Suzhou and Zhuhai IDM bases ran at high capacity utilisation with overall production yield above 95%; 747 new customer design-ins (including 17 new direct-sales customers) targeting AI, data centers, new energy vehicles and humanoid robots; the automotive-grade high-voltage platform was certified and entered mass production (automotive-grade chip deliveries +103%); humanoid-robot chip shipments 464,600 (+50%). R&D on the 4.0-generation process platform is on track and is expected to cut per-wafer manufacturing cost substantially. Outlook: it will press ahead with construction and ramp-up of 8-inch GaN-on-Si wafer capacity, upgrade process platforms to lower unit costs, and focus on AI computing power, new energy vehicles, industrial energy, embodied intelligence and consumer electronics.
quarterly_data.figure: yield above 95%; 747 new design-ins; automotive deliveries +103%
